title: ID0383329-DC/Si-D/FI-[F2S3400025] - Dispenser PLC blinks red and contactor does not close
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
PLC communication error
Root cause:
PLC payload is corrupted
Solution:
SSH transfer the dispenser's payload
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
Dispenser F2S3400025 is inside costumer warehouse. When they tried to commission it with one of the main units (
MP / R8 170002225)
, before sending it to the site, they were not able to get it working. Dispenser PLC blinks red and contactor does not close.
I'm going onsite to the warehouse today and probably would need assistance to investigate this issue.
What should be the first trouble shooting step?

additional_info.subject: ID0383329-DC/Si-D/FI-[F2S3400025] - Dispenser PLC blinks red and contactor does not close CRM:00315001890
additional_info.body:
Dear Sakari,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Warehouse unit
ChargerID/Serial No.
: Qu2jTM
Problem Description
: PLC communication error
Troubleshooting
:
From what we understood, the first time you turned on the dispenser it possibly didn't finish the update or related that might've caused the payload to corrupt.
With the assistance from L3, we were able to upload the payload again to the dispenser and it started working almost completely.
We found afterwards that the StateMonitor KF214, was not sending the 12V for the fastshutdown of the converter group3 and group4. As such we replaced the StateMonitor and now the dispenser is fully operational.
Please provide me the following information and I will close the ticket.
Defective part name/MLFB: KF214
Component serial number:
Logs with marked error (CSV format preferred): attach
Active error flags before replacement
PLC-Dispenser-Error-Flag 'DC4_StateMonitor_KF214' changed to true - (No_Bypass_LCU2: less converters than expeceted deactivated)
PLC-Dispenser-Error-Flag 'DC3_StateMonitor_KF214' changed to true - (No_Bypass_LCU3: less converters than expeceted deactivated)
PLC-Dispenser-Error-Flag 'DC3_StateMonitor_KF214' changed to true - (statemonitor LCU_DC[3])
PLC-Dispenser-Error-Flag 'DC4_StateMonitor_KF214' changed to true - (statemonitor LCU_DC[2])
Device-specific error code
(if applicable): No 12V from fastshutdown line
Outcome of wiring checkup: No 12V in output and checked fastshutdown check via RemoteDebugStation → voltage doesn't drop to 0 V in FSC
Commissioning checklist
Commissioning date
Field service report
Date of failure
(see side note): 8/Oct
For future reference, your ticket number is
0383329
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
